$comment: Pairing contract of model-card/v1 (v6.3 M2b): the modifier-constraint pairings the suite treats as supported, exactly as approved in docs/dev/v6.3/o03-model-pairings.md (owner decision 2026-10-16). Any pairing not listed is unsupported; a combination is not supported because each term appears here. The semantic lock pins this file (definition kind pairing-contract).

conditions: the parameter is the card's poi
no constraint term; may be shared by samples in several channels
exactly one constraint term for the parameter, however many samples and channels use it
hi/lo on the modifier, or a constraint width w in (0, 1) meaning hi/lo = 1 +- w; both given must agree

meanings.gaussian: a unit Gaussian constraint on the nuisance parameter alpha, not on the yield; the yield follows code4 interpolation between lo and hi
meanings.bounds: fixed by the converter, not read from the card: [-10, 50] for the poi, [0, 50] for free normalizations

unsupported: constrained-normalization with a poisson or lognormal constraint (a Combine lnN is not P3: its exponential interpolation differs from code4 beyond |alpha| = 1)
a prior constraint (the converter checks cards as frequentist only)
any modifier type outside poi, free-normalization and constrained-normalization (shapes, per-bin constraints)
a constraint on a poi or a free normalization
any Combine pairing (the adapter ships a datacard template only)
multivariate or correlated constraints, also when split into scalar ones
a joint evaluation of several model cards (the adapter has no combiner)
